g.text: AX Cross-Environment Clone — Transaction and Lineage Flow
Resolve, bind, and prove a stable source
Capture, normalize, and plan in isolated authority
[Source check, live validation, or Provider capture fails]
After Provider commit, byte rollback is forbidden.
Recovery may only complete the same deterministic suffix or park input-blocked.
Seal target authority, then publish lineage
Each environment has one companion Session Adapter.
Canonical contracts bridge them; there is no A×B converter matrix.
